data.title: OpenAI Images Edits API
data.markdown:
# OpenAI Images Edits API

Edit images by providing an input image URL and a prompt.
data.description: Edit or transform images with OpenAI-compatible image models via Ace Data Cloud.
The result data returned from this request

elapsed.description: Task processing time, unit is seconds

success.description: A flag indicating whether this request was successful.

task_id.description: The unique ID of this task, which can be used to obtain the processing results of the asynchronous task through the corresponding task query interface.

trace_id.description: The tracking ID for this request, used for issue troubleshooting.

started_at.description: The time when the task starts processing

400.description: Invalid request - request body parameter error.

429.description: The backend queue is busy, please try again later, or use `callback_url` for asynchronous processing.

504.description: The extraction operation exceeds the configured timeout.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the response format returned by the server.

url.description: Need to extract the URL of the webpage content.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

delay.description: Additional waiting time before starting extraction after the page has finished loading (unit: seconds).

headers.description: Additional HTTP request headers sent along with the page request.

timeout.description: The total timeout for the extraction operation (unit: seconds).

enable_llm.description: Whether to enable optional LLM-based semantic normalization processing at the final stage of the extraction process.

callback_url.description: If this parameter is provided, the request will be processed asynchronously, and the final result will be sent to this URL via a POST request.

expected_type.description: Indicate the expected page type to optimize extraction results.

block_resources.description: Resource types to be intercepted during page loading to speed up extraction.

wait_for_selector.description: Wait for the CSS selector to appear before starting the extraction.
